scope: 2025 ICPC Chengdu A B C D E G J K L
limitations: Small-case algorithm checks only; no online submissions or extreme-scale timing. K deque and L DSU-on-tree optimization are explained but not performance-tested.

A.method: integer construction checked against independent exact rounding intervals and exact fraction rounding

B.method: max-plus power versus recursive enumeration of all feasible skill subsets for each round

C.method: two reverse schedules versus exact DP over every interleaving of sorted bank arrivals

D.method: full reachable-state BFS, shortest path length limit, terminal-turn rejection and independent ball-list replay of 500 paths

E.method: five-query signed-area reconstruction for every N4..200, radii1/3/100, center/vertex/far/random points, both full precision and 10 significant digit replies

G.method: all replacement arrays for n<=4, all target gcds and budgets; exact disjoint subset packing

J.method: all rebuttal subsets on random score tables including zero scores and negative thresholds

K.method: all moved segments and all relevant new positions versus disjoint/left-overlap/right-overlap prefix identities; deque optimization not timed

L.method: every subtree of random trees versus exact wildcard bipartite matching; DSU traversal optimization not benchmarked
